PALLETS ENGINEERED FOR AUTOMATION

A stable pallet is the first interface of a reliable AS/RS.

Storack manufactures injection-molded HDPE pallets for automated warehouses. We help integrators and operators confirm structure, deflection, rack interfaces and reinforcement before an order moves into production.

DESIGN AROUND THE SYSTEM

The pallet must work with more than the load.

In an AS/RS, the pallet interacts with conveyors, stacker cranes, shuttles, rack beams, locators and sensors. Storack reviews these interfaces as one operating system—not as isolated specifications.

  • Clear support span, load distribution and rack-load definition
  • Fork, conveyor and shuttle entry direction confirmation
  • Steel-tube layout selected around the actual support points
  • Color, marking, logo and identification options for fleet control

FROM REQUIREMENT TO DELIVERY

A specification process built to reduce mismatch

A clear confirmation path helps protect automation uptime and makes later replenishment more predictable.

  1. Collect conditions

    Confirm dimensions, unit load, support span, handling equipment and environment.

  2. Match structure

    Select deck, runner base, steel reinforcement and functional options.

  3. Approve sample

    Review drawing and sample against interfaces before mass production.

  4. Control delivery

    Manage inspection, marking, packaging and export documentation.
